note: The content color library for IDEA HTML assignments (AUTHORING D3). Every entry names what it stands for and where its anchor value comes from. build.mjs solves each one separately for the dark (idea) and light (space-white) themes into an ink (text), a fill (marks, bands, badges), an on (text on the fill), a line (the fill's edge) and a wash (a quiet tint), and test.mjs judges the result. 'verified' means the value was read from the owner's published source; 'approx' means a documented conversion or a widely used value not published by the owner. The linking set (status linking) is for phases and for tying a term to its part of a diagram when nothing real has a color. An author may add an entry in the source's hx-colors block with an anchor and a why; it is judged the same way. Sources: research_notes/Theme aware assignment color system/anchor_colors.md (2026-10-26).
